Divine Mercy Sunday in 2026 is celebrated on April 12, 2026, which is the Second Sunday of Easter (the Octave of Easter). It is a significant feast day in the Catholic Church, offering a plenary indulgence for those who participate in its rituals, including confession and communion, and a nine-day novena beginning on Good Friday, April 3, 2026. Key Details for 2026: Date: Sunday, April 12, 2026. Novena Start: Good Friday, April 3, 2026. Significance: It is a day focused on receiving God's mercy and forgiveness, often marked by special devotions such as the Divine Mercy Chaplet, attending Mass, and taking part in confession. Celebrations: Various parishes and shrines, including the National Shrine of the Divine Mercy, hold special services. Indulgence: A plenary indulgence can be obtained on this day under the usual conditions (sacramental confession, Eucharistic Communion, and prayer for the Pope's intentions). Commonly Held Traditions: Divine Mercy Image: Displaying and venerating the Image of the Merciful Jesus ("Jesus, I trust in You"). Confession & Communion: Receiving the Sacrament of Reconciliation and Holy Communion. Novena: Praying the Divine Mercy Novena, which begins on Good Friday.
